ios.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Face ID is used to unlock the app.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Microphone access is needed to turn your voice notes into follow-ups.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Photo library access is needed to turn your screenshots or selected images into follow-ups.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: This app does not save photos to your library.
ios.NSContactsUsageDescription: Lets you pick a person's phone number from your contacts. The app only sees the contact you choose.
